lanes.name: Agent
lanes.hint: Agent-driven Customer 360 actions across all capabilities

lanes.name: Customer 360 System
lanes.hint: Validation, derived display logic, ticket generation (BR-01..BR-11)

lanes.name: Source Systems (CRM / IDWise-MOI / Billing System)
lanes.hint: Systems Involved per Capability_Summary: CRM, IDWise, MOI, Billing System, DXP, Siebel CRM

nodes.label: Identify Customer Account
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to identify the customer account associated with an interaction before performing any Customer 360 action.

nodes.label: Identify Customer
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to identify the customer using the supported identification attributes before proceeding with Customer 360 actions.

nodes.label: Verify Customer Identity
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to verify the identified customer's identity before undertaking any customer, contact, address or billing maintenance action, consistent with BR-01.

nodes.label: Navigate to Customer 360
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to navigate to the Customer 360 page for a verified customer to view and manage that customer's information.

nodes.label: Display Customer Profile
nodes.desc: System shall display customer profile attributes including account, contact, segmentation and service information.

nodes.label: View Account Hierarchy
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view customer account hierarchy comprising Customer Account, Billing Account and Service Account.

nodes.label: Navigate Hierarchy Levels
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to navigate between Customer Account, Billing Account and Service Account levels.

nodes.label: Retrieve Billing/Usage Overview
nodes.desc: Customer 360 shall display current outstanding/bill/charges, previous payment/outstanding, barring status/type/reason, Promise-to-Pay status/amount/dates, collection status/scenario/stage/action, current voice/data usage, data balance, spend, Call Detail Records, penalty amount/type/status, and IN-platform main/data/voice/SMS balances of the selected billing account/service.

nodes.label: View Demographic Details
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view customer demographic information.

nodes.label: ID Scanning and Validation
nodes.sub: CUS-001-KYC-03 · BR-01 (moved before Edit Demographic Details)
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to scan customer ID and perform MOI validation. Corrected sequencing: this validation gate is placed before Edit Demographic Details, per BR-01 (no maintenance until validation succeeds).

nodes.label: Edit Demographic Details
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to edit customer demographic details after successful validation.

nodes.label: Automatic Trouble Ticket Creation
nodes.desc: System shall automatically create a ticket when demographic information is modified.

nodes.label: Save Demographic Changes
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to save demographic changes and view updated information.

nodes.label: View Contact List
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view all customer contacts associated with the account.

nodes.label: View Contact Details
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view detailed customer contact information.

nodes.label: Edit Contact Details
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to edit permitted customer contact details. Restricted fields such as ID Type and ID Number shall remain non-editable per BR-03.

nodes.label: Contact Update Ticket Creation
nodes.desc: System shall create a ticket whenever contact information is modified.

nodes.label: View Address Details
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view customer address information.

nodes.label: Edit Address Details
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to update address information manually after validation.

nodes.label: Address Update Ticket Creation
nodes.desc: System shall create a ticket when customer address is modified.

nodes.label: Dynamic Address Filtering
nodes.desc: System shall filter available street and building values based on selected address attributes.

nodes.label: Navigate to Billing Account
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to navigate from customer account to billing account.

nodes.label: View Billing Profile
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view billing profile information.

nodes.label: View Billing Contact
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view billing contact information.

nodes.label: Edit Billing Contact
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to edit authorized billing contact information.

nodes.label: Edit Billing Address
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to update billing address after successful validation.

nodes.label: Edit Billing Language
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to update billing language from predefined options.

nodes.label: Edit Payment Mode
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to update customer payment mode.

nodes.label: View Bills
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view customer billing history for the last 12 months.

nodes.label: View Outstanding Information
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view outstanding amounts and balances.

nodes.label: Download and Resend Invoice
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to download, print and resend customer invoices. Per BR-06, an invoice may be downloaded, printed or resent only by an authorised agent.

nodes.label: View Service Accounts
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view service account information.

nodes.label: View Installed Assets
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view installed assets associated with service accounts.

nodes.label: View Customer Interactions
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view customer interactions performed via email, SMS and phone.

nodes.label: Interaction Tracking
nodes.desc: System shall generate a unique interaction identifier for each interaction.

nodes.label: View Sent Communications
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view SMS and email communications associated with customer interactions.

nodes.label: View Attachments
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view customer account attachments.

nodes.label: Download Attachments
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to download customer account attachments.

nodes.label: View Archived Documents
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to access archived customer documents through archival links.

nodes.label: View Archived Documents (duplicate)
nodes.sub: CUS-001-ATT-01 (New Req ID CUS-001-SEQ-067) — flagged duplicate of CUS-001-ATT-03
nodes.desc: DUPLICATE CONTENT flagged during correction: this row (Req ID CUS-001-ATT-01, New Req ID CUS-001-SEQ-067) repeats row 80 (CUS-001-ATT-03, New Req ID CUS-001-SEQ-066) near-verbatim -- identical Requirement Name, Requirement Statement and Acceptance Criteria. Retained in the model, unchanged, pending a business decision on consolidation; not deleted per the correction methodology.

agents.Name: Customer Identification and Verification
agents.Purpose / Feature: Customer search and identification using QID, Passport, GCC ID, Diplomatic ID, Mobile Number and Account ID, including IDWise scanning, MOI validation and customer verification.

agents.Name: Customer Account Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: Consolidates customer profile and account management in a hierarchy, including demographic, contact and address viewing and updates, validation and verification, dynamic address selection, and automatic ticket generation for approved changes. Also provides visibility of the customer's service accounts, subscribed services and installed assets within the selected customer and account context.

agents.Name: Billing Account Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: Billing account hierarchy, billing profile and contact management, payment profile management, and billing account maintenance.

agents.Name: Attachment Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: View, upload, download and maintain customer supporting documents and archived attachments.

agents.Name: Ticket, Search and Activity
agents.Purpose / Feature: Consolidates ticket visibility, search, assignment and queue management with customer activity and interaction history across SMS, email, calls and customer-service interactions.

agents.Name: Billing Information and Invoice View
agents.Purpose / Feature: Invoice history, outstanding balance visibility, invoice download, resend and billing inquiry support.

identify_account.title: Identify Customer Account
identify_account.does: Agent identifies the customer account tied to the current interaction.
identify_account.example: CUS-001-CAM-01: Given an agent starts a Customer 360 interaction, the associated customer account shall be available for the agent to proceed.

identify_customer.title: Identify Customer
identify_customer.does: Agent identifies the customer using supported identification attributes.
identify_customer.example: CUS-001-KYC-01: Given identification attributes are provided, the matching customer record shall be identified.

verify_customer.title: Verify Customer Identity
verify_customer.does: System/agent verifies the identified customer's identity before any maintenance action is allowed.
verify_customer.makes: Verified customer status (gate for all maintenance actions)
verify_customer.example: CUS-001-KYC-02 / BR-01: The agent shall not undertake demographic, address or billing-address maintenance until the customer has successfully completed the prescribed validation process.

navigate_c360.title: Navigate to Customer 360
navigate_c360.does: Agent opens the Customer 360 page for the verified customer.
navigate_c360.example: CUS-001-CAM-04 (SEQ-004): Given a customer has been identified and verified, the Customer 360 page for that customer shall open successfully.

display_profile.title: Display Customer Profile
display_profile.example: CUS-001-CAM-02: Configured profile fields shall be displayed on the Customer 360 page.

view_hierarchy.title: View Account Hierarchy
view_hierarchy.does: Agent views the account hierarchy tree.
view_hierarchy.example: CUS-001-CAM-03: Hierarchy shall be displayed in tree structure.

navigate_hierarchy.title: Navigate Hierarchy Levels
navigate_hierarchy.example: CUS-001-CAM-04: Selected account level shall open successfully.

billing_overview.title: Retrieve Billing / Usage Overview
billing_overview.does: System retrieves and displays the full set of billing, barring, collection, usage and penalty attributes for the selected billing account/service.
billing_overview.makes: Outstanding amount, bill amount, charges, previous payment/outstanding, barring status/type/reason, Promise-to-Pay status/amount/dates, collection status/scenario/stage/action, voice/data usage, data balance, spend, CDRs, penalty amount/type/status, IN-platform balances
billing_overview.example: CUS-001-BIV-01: Given a billing account is selected, when billing information is retrieved, then the current outstanding amount shall be displayed. (BR-07 billing dues visibility, BR-08 barring status visibility, BR-09 collection status visibility, BR-10 current voice usage visibility, BR-11 penalty amount visibility)

manage_demography_start.title: View Demographic Details
manage_demography_start.example: CUS-001-CAM-08: Demographic details shall be displayed from customer profile.

id_scan_validate.title: ID Scanning and Validation
id_scan_validate.does: Agent scans the customer's ID and the system performs MOI validation before demographic maintenance is allowed.
id_scan_validate.example: CUS-001-KYC-03: System shall return validation outcome before update is allowed. (BR-01: no maintenance until validation succeeds -- moved ahead of Edit Demographic Details in the corrected sequence)

edit_demography.title: Edit Demographic Details
edit_demography.does: Agent edits demographic details after validation.
edit_demography.example: CUS-001-CAM-09: System shall allow update only for authorized users.

demography_ticket.title: Automatic Trouble Ticket Creation
demography_ticket.does: System auto-creates a ticket on demographic change.
demography_ticket.makes: Unique ticket ID assigned to initiating agent
demography_ticket.example: CUS-001-CAM-10 / BR-04: Unique ticket ID shall be generated and assigned to initiating agent, used as the operational reference for follow-up, escalation and audit.

save_demography.title: Save Demographic Changes
save_demography.does: Agent saves changes and views updated info.
save_demography.example: CUS-001-CAM-11: Updated details shall be reflected in Customer 360.

view_contact_list.title: View Contact List
view_contact_list.does: Agent views all contacts on the account.
view_contact_list.example: CUS-001-CAM-12: System shall display all associated contacts.

view_contact_details.title: View Contact Details
view_contact_details.does: Agent views a contact's detailed profile.
view_contact_details.example: CUS-001-CAM-13: Detailed contact profile shall be displayed successfully.

edit_contact.title: Edit Contact Details
edit_contact.does: Agent edits permitted contact fields; ID Type/Number stay locked.
edit_contact.example: CUS-001-CAM-14 / BR-03: Restricted fields such as ID Type and ID Number shall remain non-editable; correction of those follows the approved KYC identity-correction process.

contact_ticket.title: Contact Update Ticket Creation
contact_ticket.does: System creates a ticket on contact change.
contact_ticket.makes: Unique ticket linked to the update request
contact_ticket.example: CUS-001-CAM-15: Unique ticket shall be generated and linked to the update request.

view_address.title: View Address Details
view_address.example: CUS-001-CAM-16: Address information shall be displayed successfully.

edit_address.title: Edit Address Details
edit_address.example: CUS-001-CAM-17: Address information shall be saved successfully.

address_ticket.title: Address Update Ticket Creation
address_ticket.does: System creates a ticket on address change.
address_ticket.example: CUS-001-CAM-18: Ticket ID shall be generated automatically.

dynamic_address_filter.title: Dynamic Address Filtering
dynamic_address_filter.does: System filters street/building options as the agent selects address attributes.
dynamic_address_filter.example: CUS-001-CAM-19: Only valid address values shall be available for selection.

navigate_billing_account.title: Navigate to Billing Account
navigate_billing_account.does: Agent navigates from customer to billing account, confirming billing context per BR-05.
navigate_billing_account.example: CUS-001-BAM-01 / BR-05: Billing account details page shall open successfully; agent confirms intended billing-account context before maintenance.

view_billing_profile.title: View Billing Profile
view_billing_profile.example: CUS-001-BAM-02: Billing profile fields shall be displayed.

view_billing_contact.title: View Billing Contact
view_billing_contact.example: CUS-001-BAM-03: Billing contact details shall be displayed successfully.

edit_billing_contact.title: Edit Billing Contact
edit_billing_contact.does: Authorised agent edits billing contact info.
edit_billing_contact.example: CUS-001-BAM-04: Updated billing contact information shall be stored successfully.

edit_billing_address.title: Edit Billing Address
edit_billing_address.does: Agent updates billing address after validation.
edit_billing_address.example: CUS-001-BAM-05: Address updates shall be saved successfully.

edit_billing_language.title: Edit Billing Language
edit_billing_language.does: Agent updates billing language from a predefined list.
edit_billing_language.example: CUS-001-BAM-06: New billing language shall be saved successfully.

edit_payment_mode.title: Edit Payment Mode
edit_payment_mode.does: Agent updates the customer's payment mode.
edit_payment_mode.makes: Updated payment mode reflected in billing profile
edit_payment_mode.example: CUS-001-BAM-07: Updated payment mode shall be reflected in billing profile.

view_bills.title: View Bills
view_bills.does: Agent views up to 12 months of billing history.
view_bills.makes: Bill records within the supported period
view_bills.example: CUS-001-BIV-26: System shall display bill records within supported period.

view_outstanding_info.title: View Outstanding Information
view_outstanding_info.example: CUS-001-BIV-27: Outstanding information shall be displayed in real time.

download_resend_invoice.title: Download and Resend Invoice
download_resend_invoice.does: Authorised agent downloads, prints or resends an invoice.
download_resend_invoice.example: CUS-001-BIV-28 / BR-06: Invoice action shall complete successfully; only an authorised agent may perform this per the approved document-distribution procedure.

view_service_accounts.title: View Service Accounts
view_service_accounts.example: CUS-001-CAM-20: Service account information shall be displayed successfully.

view_installed_assets.title: View Installed Assets
view_installed_assets.does: Agent views installed assets on service accounts.
view_installed_assets.example: CUS-001-CAM-21: Asset details shall be displayed successfully.

view_interactions.title: View Customer Interactions
view_interactions.does: Agent views interaction history across channels.
view_interactions.example: CUS-001-VEW-01: Interaction history shall be displayed successfully.

interaction_tracking.title: Interaction Tracking
interaction_tracking.does: System auto-generates a unique interaction identifier.
interaction_tracking.example: CUS-001-VEW-02: Unique interaction ID shall be created automatically.

view_sent_comms.title: View Sent Communications
view_sent_comms.does: Agent views SMS/email communications tied to interactions.
view_sent_comms.example: CUS-001-VEW-03: Communication history shall be available for viewing.

view_attachments.title: View Attachments
view_attachments.example: CUS-001-ATT-01: Associated attachments shall be displayed successfully.

download_attachments.title: Download Attachments
download_attachments.example: CUS-001-ATT-01: Selected attachment shall download successfully.

view_archived_docs.title: View Archived Documents
view_archived_docs.does: Agent opens an archived document via its archival link.
view_archived_docs.example: CUS-001-ATT-03: Archived document shall open successfully when selected.

view_archived_docs_dup.title: View Archived Documents (duplicate)
view_archived_docs_dup.does: Duplicate of the row above -- same archived-document access capability, flagged not removed.
view_archived_docs_dup.example: CUS-001-ATT-01 (SEQ-067): Archived document shall open successfully when selected. Flagged as duplicate content of SEQ-066 during BRSD correction; retained for traceability, not consolidated.
